details: President Trump has agreed to tougher ethics provisions in the final draft of the Clarity Act, a move designed to facilitate the crypto bill's passage through the Senate. This development occurs as a bipartisan coalition of 18 state attorneys general, led by New York AG Letitia James, actively opposes the current version, citing concerns over investor protections ahead of a crucial Senate procedural vote. The bill aims to establish a clear regulatory framework for digital assets in the U.S.
title: Trump Backs Ethics Rules for Clarity Act, Faces State AG Opposition

details: Bloomberg Intelligence strategist Mike McGlone has highlighted increased risks for Bitcoin, attributing them to its correlation with the S&P 500 and inherent volatility. He identified key factors like resistance at $80,000 and expectations of further Fed rate hikes as pressures. McGlone warned that a 20% decline in the S&P 500 could potentially drive Bitcoin's price down to $10,000, although a break from traditional stock market trends might avert this scenario.
title: Bloomberg Analyst McGlone Warns Bitcoin Could Drop to $10K

details: The cryptocurrency market is preparing for potential volatility as major financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan, now anticipate a 25-basis-point interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve at its upcoming September FOMC meeting. This expectation is fueled by recent higher-than-expected August inflation data and a surge in oil prices, with market probabilities for a hike currently around 87%. Bitcoin ETFs have also seen outflows, indicating investor de-risking.
title: Goldman Sachs & JPMorgan Expect Fed Rate Hike, Crypto Braces for Volatility

details: Bitcoin has shown resilience, climbing to approximately $78,000, as it appears to decouple from a broader selloff in U.S. technology and AI-related stocks. The tech sector downturn was triggered by prominent AI CEOs expressing renewed concerns over the rapid pace of AI development and calling for a slowdown. Despite significant drops in AI stocks, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP recorded gains, suggesting a unique market dynamic without a specific crypto catalyst.
title: Bitcoin Climbs to $78K, Decouples from AI-Driven Tech Stock Decline

details: Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin treasury company Strive has expanded its Bitcoin holdings to exactly 25,000 BTC, following a recent acquisition of 469 Bitcoin for approximately $36.6 million. This purchase, made between September 8 and September 11 at an average price of $77,954 per BTC, was funded through the sale of Strive's perpetual preferred stock (SATA). The move solidifies Strive's position as the fifth-largest publicly traded Bitcoin company.
title: Strive Accumulates 25,000 BTC in Treasury After Latest $36.6M Purchase

details: KULR Technology Group, a battery technology company, has fully divested its Bitcoin treasury, selling its remaining 764 BTC for approximately $58.6 million. These sales, executed between August 20 and September 11 at an average price of $76,633 per Bitcoin, aim to provide liquidity for the company's primary energy business. This marks a complete departure from KULR's previous strategy of holding Bitcoin as a treasury asset.
title: KULR Technology Group Exits Bitcoin Treasury, Sells All 764 BTC
